summary: Learn to measure data freshness, assess event quality and frame live analytics decisions. Explore the 10-day course outline.
lede: Real-time data analytics helps data analysts, operations specialists and technical leads assess whether live data supports timely decisions. Learners measure freshness and latency, review event schemas and quality controls, and specify pipeline alerts and dashboard requirements using streaming concepts. These capabilities help them judge data usefulness, communicate limitations and raise readiness and governance questions before data is reused in AI and analytics initiatives.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who work with event data, operational reporting or the decisions that depend on timely information. It is designed for foundation-level learners who need to assess real-time analytics use without assuming prior streaming-platform experience.
prerequisites: No prior streaming-platform experience is required. Basic data literacy and familiarity with spreadsheets are recommended. Coding is not required; advanced streaming and AI concepts receive conceptual or operational treatment, not hands-on implementation.
